<description>
Enabling the string performance clang-tidy rules should be fine and easy.

E.g. on aarch64, when running the `BlockToJsonVerboseWrite` bench, I can see a minimal 0.3% drop in instructions and 0.6% drop in branches.
</description>

<commits>

No need to create a std::string copy

faae016796 refactor: Enable performance-prefer-single-char-overloads

bbbb9c6d73 refactor: Enable performance-faster-string-find

It is an alias of the previously enabled rule. See https://releases.llvm.org/23.1.0/tools/clang/tools/extra/docs/clang-tidy/checks/performance/faster-string-find.html

fabb6bbe53 refactor: Use single-char overload in execute_process WIN32 block
